jOkzESsmwIgQuN7OXjbyaQ.zh: 喬治亞首都提比里斯(Tbilisi)於9/17-21累計報告逾100例住院病例,其中多件檢體檢出諾羅病毒,病患分布於20所幼兒園。當局表示多所幼兒園同時爆發疫情,可能與集中供應的餐點受污染有關,目前病患多已逐漸恢復,感染源仍調查中。
jOkzESsmwIgQuN7OXjbyaQ.en: In the capital, Tbilisi, more than 100 hospitalised cases were reported cumulatively during 17–21 September. Several specimens tested positive for norovirus, and patients were distributed across 20 kindergartens. Authorities say the simultaneous outbreaks in several kindergartens may be linked to contaminated centrally supplied meals. Most patients are gradually recovering, and the source of infection is still under investigation.

6LTLUuWxJ8cLyDrqduq_Nw.zh: 伊拉克疫情更新,今年迄今報告125例,其中21例死亡,以該國南部濟加爾省(Dhi Qar)36例為多,病患多數為牲畜相關業者,該國規劃針對非法放牧、屠宰及牲畜販運採取更嚴的管制。 喬治亞南部薩姆茨赫-賈瓦赫蒂區今年迄今報告3例,其中2例死亡,該區人類感染病例占全國80%以上,該國已針對該區大型牲畜場域進行殺蟎劑處理,以減少蜱蟲數量。
6LTLUuWxJ8cLyDrqduq_Nw.en: Iraq's update: so far this year, 125 cases have been reported, including 21 deaths, with 36 cases in Dhi Qar Province in the south. Most patients are livestock-related workers. Iraq plans stricter controls on illegal grazing, slaughter and livestock trafficking. Georgia: in the Samtskhe–Javakheti region in the south, 3 cases have been reported so far this year, 2 of them fatal. This region accounts for more than 80% of human cases nationally. The country has applied acaricide treatment to large livestock areas in the region to reduce tick numbers.
